articles.title: Global Market: South Korean shares set to end seven-week losing streak
articles.content: South Korean shares were poised to end a seven-week losing streak, with the Kospi rising 0.82% to a three-week high, supported by AI-driven chip gains and stronger U.S. technology stocks. SK Hynix and automakers advanced, while Samsung Electronics slipped. Foreign investors bought stocks, while easing U.S. inflation boosted market sentiment.

articles.title: Gold prices fall Rs 2,600/gram in 2 days; silver dips Rs 5,000/kg as Iran war fears mount again. Buy, sell or hold?
articles.content: Gold and silver prices declined on the MCX as investors booked profits after a sharp rally, with silver falling Rs 5,000 over two days and gold down Rs 2,600 per gram. Analysts expect near-term profit booking in gold, while silver could move towards Rs 2,40,000 per kg amid strong investment demand and geopolitical uncertainty.

articles.title: Fitch affirms US at AA+ with stable outlook, flags fiscal and inflation risks
articles.content: Fitch Ratings affirmed the US sovereign credit rating at AA+ with a stable outlook, citing economic resilience and the dollar’s reserve-currency status. However, the agency flagged persistent fiscal deficits, elevated inflation, rising interest costs and weakening labour demand as key risks, with the US deficit forecast at 7.4% of GDP in 2026.

articles.title: US Stock Market: Regulatory filing shows Elon Musk owns 48.4% of SpaceX
articles.content: Elon Musk owns a 48.4% stake in SpaceX, according to a regulatory filing, giving him more than 82% of the company’s voting power. His holding is valued at over $900 billion, highlighting his dominant control over the space and AI-focused company.

articles.title: Global Market: Japan’s Nikkei extends weekly gains as softer US inflation boosts risk appetite
articles.content: Japan’s Nikkei 225 rose nearly 1% on Friday and was on track for a strong weekly gain, supported by softer-than-expected US producer prices, easing concerns over an imminent Fed rate hike and stronger global risk appetite. Technology stocks led gains, while lower oil prices also supported sentiment.

articles.title: India's Bank of Baroda raises $700 million via dollar bonds at tighter spreads
articles.content: Bank of Baroda has successfully accepted bids totaling seven hundred million dollars for its debt offering, achieving narrower spreads than anticipated for its bonds. This marks the bank's first foray into the dollar bond market in seven years. Supported by a central bank facility, Indian banks are borrowing funds at more favorable rates, with proceeds from this sale designated for diverse financial requirements while carrying a BBB rating.

articles.title: Skyways Air sets price band for Rs 582.8 crore IPO; issue to open on Aug 24
articles.content: Skyways Air Services will launch its ₹582.8 crore IPO on August 24, with the price band set at ₹131–138 per share. The issue will close on August 27 and comprises a ₹398.8 crore fresh issue and ₹184 crore OFS. Proceeds from the fresh issue will be used to strengthen the balance sheet, reduce debt and meet working capital needs.

articles.title: Advent-backed Svatantra Microfin files for $315 million IPO
articles.content: Svatantra Microfin has filed for an initial public offering worth thirty billion rupees. Existing investors Advent International and Multiples are offloading shares worth fifteen billion rupees. The microfinance company primarily provides loans to women in rural areas. Svatantra reported a forty-five point eight percent jump in net profit for the year. Proceeds from the IPO will boost the company's Tier I capital base.
